name: Gaurishankar Temple, Khatu
town_description: Khatu Shyamji (Khatu) is a pilgrimage town in Sikar district (Danta Ramgarh area), about 80 km from Jaipur, dominated by the white-marble Khatu Shyam Temple dedicated to Barbarika/Shyam Baba. It draws millions of pilgrims, especially during the Falgun Mela, and is ringed by smaller shrines, sacred kunds, and dharamshalas.

travel.railway: Ringas Junction, about 18 km away; taxis and buses connect to Khatu.
travel.road: About 80 km from Jaipur via NH-52; well connected by bus and taxi.
